english_level_required: None stated; Spanish B2 required instead
tuition_notes: Master NO habilitante, Grupo 3 (Ingenierias y Arquitectura), 1a matricula = 13,68 EUR/credit. ARITHMETIC: 13,68 x 60 ECTS = 820.80 EUR total. Add one-off admin fees: apertura de expediente 59,10 + tarjeta identidad 5,70 = 64,80. Master title issue 176,00 on graduation. UMA IS THE ONE EXCEPTION that publishes an art.3.2 clause: its master fee annex applies the tariffs 'con caracter provisional a los estudiantes de nacionalidad extranjera ... que no tengan la condicion de residente -temporal o de larga duracion- en Espana O LA AUTORIZACION DE ESTANCIA POR ESTUDIOS', with a complementary charge of up to 100% of real cost if proof is not filed by 1 November. CRUCIALLY - and unlike Madrid Decreto 43/2022 art.8, where a student-stay permit does NOT count as residence - the student-stay authorisation EXPLICITLY COUNTS at UMA. A Tunisian on a Spanish student visa satisfies it and pays the standard rate; the only real risk is missing the 1 November document deadline. NO non-EU surcharge applies. Andalusian Decreto 98/2023 (BOJA 84, 05/05/2023) Anexo I apdo.1. Column heading verbatim: 'Precio segun la vez de matricula / 1.a 2.a 3.a 4.a y ss.' - bands are keyed ONLY to enrolment attempt and experimentality group; NO column is keyed to nationality or residence. Art.3.1-3.2 is the only nationality article: non-EEA/Swiss students pay 'los precios previstos en este decreto'; art.3.2 merely PERMITS a university to vary the credit price for NON-RESIDENT foreigners (cap 100% of cost of service). Decreto 142/2025 (BOJA 172, 08/09/2025) amends only arts.5/6/12/14/DF1 and Anexo I apdo.2 (administrative fees) - it leaves art.3 and the per-credit table untouched, so these rates stand for 2026/27.

entry_requirements_summary: Andalusian Distrito Unico Andaluz (DUA) single application: one form covers all 9 public Andalusian universities, ranking up to 6 masters by preference. Non-EHEA degrees need NO homologacion - DUA states VERBATIM: 'sin necesidad de homologacion del titulo, pero si de comprobacion por parte de la universidad del nivel de formacion que implican, siempre y cuando en el pais donde se haya expedido dicho titulo permita acceder a estudios del nivel de posgrado'. Requires DUA Anexo II 'Modelo de certificacion de acceso a estudios de masteres oficiales en el pais de origen' from the home university. DUA access list for this master runs to 118 named degrees and EXPLICITLY includes GRADO EN INGENIERIA INFORMATICA, INGENIERO EN INFORMATICA, GRADO EN INGENIERIA INFORMATICA - INGENIERIA SOFTWARE, GRADO EN INGENIERIA SOFTWARE, GRADO EN INGENIERIA DEL SOFTWARE Y VIDEOJUEGOS, plus every Telecomunicacion and Sonido e Imagen variant. Ranking baremo: academic record, prior training, professional experience. Spanish B2 (CEFR) required of foreign applicants - stated on the DUA ficha. This is the real barrier, not money.
red_flags: Semi-presencial (blended) delivery, not fully on-campus - check residence/visa implications for a student visa that normally assumes in-person study. Only 25 places. Taught in Spanish. UMA's non-resident document deadline of 1 November must not be missed or a top-up of up to 100% of real cost can be levied. Scholarships not investigated in this fee-focused sweep.
fit_notes: STRONGEST FIND OF THIS SWEEP. Acoustics taught inside a TELECOMMUNICATIONS engineering school - so the signal-processing/electroacoustics framing the client wants, not the civil-engineering framing UGR and UCA use. It is the ONLY acoustics master in Andalusia whose access list names Ingenieria Informatica explicitly, which is the strongest possible admissions signal for this client. RUCT 4312714, 60 ECTS, 1 year. Client's 300-ECTS 5-year diploma vastly exceeds any entry bar. Total tuition ~821 EUR + ~65 EUR admin.

fit_notes: Ministry code 4314325, 60 ECTS, interuniversity UGR+UCA: Granada teaches Architectural Acoustics, Cadiz teaches Environmental Acoustics; you complete the whole master at one university. Qualifies the holder as 'Tecnico competente' in acoustic contamination under Andalusian Decreto 6/2012. Client's 300-ECTS engineering diploma comfortably clears the bar, but the access profile is built around civil/architectural engineers, so a software-engineering applicant should expect to argue adequacy of prior training (an explicit admission requirement).
